name: Trial Runner
summary: The Proving Grounds as a build: run a season trial against any build with the official plugin eval runner, wrap the report into a BuildGuild evidence file, and author new eval cases in the same format.

agentProfiles.tools: Read, Bash (claude plugin eval, node cli/buildguild.mjs, gh gist)
agentProfiles.limits: Submits only after showing the payload

Season 0 release: run-trial and write-eval-case skills.
